title: Capitals of Africa (hot and cold)
intro: 10 capital cities of Africa, one after another. You have three tries for each city and are told warmer or colder after a miss. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Maseru
rounds.fact: Maseru is the capital of Lesotho.
